# SOP-P1-L1-02 Product changeover - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03  
Related: ECN-2026-003, SB-1009, SB-1025

1. Purpose and scope  
   1.1 Purpose: Define required activities, roles, and records to perform a safe, repeatable product changeover on the Hot Forge line (P1-L1) covering EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, and EQ-P1-L1-IH03.  
   1.2 Scope: Applies to operations, maintenance, and quality personnel executing mechanical, tooling, and CNC configuration steps during changeover.

2. Background and rationale  
   2.1 Background: Changeovers on the Hot Forge line include mechanical setups on the radial ring rolling mill, tooling and lubrication verification on CNC turning centers, and inspection handling at the induction heater. Consistent procedure reduces scrap, prevents equipment damage, and preserves process traceability.  
   2.2 Rationale: Explicit torque and lubricant specifications are provided to eliminate variability that leads to mandrel slippage, premature tool wear, or part out-of-spec. The specification below is mandatory for the named equipment models.

3. Preconditions (must be confirmed before starting)  
   3.1 Work permit for mechanical work is valid and visible at equipment site.  
   3.2 Machine power is locked out and tagged per site lockout policy.  
   3.3 All required tooling and materials are staged at the work area.  
   3.4 Required personnel have completed job-specific training and read ECN-2026-003 and SB-1009 where referenced.  
   3.5 Inspection measurements and previous run sheets for the outgoing product are archived and available.

4. Personal protective equipment (PPE) required  
   4.1 Hearing protection certified for facility noise environment.  
   4.2 Cut-resistant gloves for handling tooling and mandrels.  
   4.3 Safety glasses with side shields.  
   4.4 Flame-resistant clothing when working adjacent to induction heater operations on EQ-P1-L1-IH03.  
   4.5 Steel-toe footwear.  
   Note: Ensure PPE is donned before work begins and remain in place until sign-off.

5. Preparatory steps (verify before mechanical steps)  
   5.1 Verify that the incoming work order and ECN-2026-003 change instruction match the new product configuration.  
   5.2 Confirm tooling list against SB-1009. Remove obsolete tooling and tag for return or maintenance.  
   5.3 Stage calibration gages and inspection fixtures referenced in SB-1025.

6. Changeover sequence (mechanical, CNC, inspection)  
   6.1 Radial ring rolling mill (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) mechanical setup  
       6.1.1 Remove previous mandrel and clean seating surfaces using lint-free cloth and approved solvent.  
       6.1.2 Install new mandrel. Confirm mandrel keying aligns with locating features.  
       6.1.3 The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 635 N·m. Apply torque using a calibrated torque wrench and confirm reading on the torque wrench calibration label. Document torque reading on the changeover record.  
       6.1.4 Rotate mandrel by hand to verify free rotation and absence of binding after torquing.

   6.2 CNC turning center (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) setup  
       6.2.1 Load new program and verify program revision matches the work order. Cross-reference SB-1009 for acceptable program versions.  
       6.2.2 Install turning tools and set tool offsets according to the program tool list. Use protected hands and eye protection while changing tools.  
       6.2.3 Apply lubricant to specified points. The lubricant part number for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) is CFW-LUB-508. Record the lubricant part number and lot number on the maintenance checklist.  
       6.2.4 Verify spindle and turret interlocks before enabling automatic motion.

   6.3 Induction heater and transfer (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) checks  
       6.3.1 Confirm heater control file matches the product family per ECN-2026-003.  
       6.3.2 Inspect conveyor and handling fixtures for wear and secure attachments. Replace or tag items requiring maintenance.  
       6.3.3 Conduct a dry run of part transfer without heat or workpiece to validate timing and sequence.

7. Validation and trial run  
   7.1 Perform a low-risk trial run using a setup coupon or the first production piece as designated.  
   7.2 Measure critical dimensions and surface condition per SB-1025. Log measurement results on the first-piece inspection form.  
   7.3 If measurements are within acceptance, authorize full production. If out of tolerance, stop and perform corrective actions documented and approved per change control ECN-2026-003.

8. Examples and common failure modes (for operator awareness)  
   8.1 Example: Under-torqued mandrel clamp may allow axial slip visible as part ovality on final inspection. Confirm torque and re-check first-piece geometry if slip is suspected.  
   8.2 Example: Wrong lubricant may cause increased spindle temperature or abnormal tool wear. Always confirm CFW-LUB-508 visually and by lot label before use.  
   8.3 Common failure modes: incorrect program version, loose tooling set screws, and contaminated mating surfaces. Address each with the corrective checklist.

9. Records to keep and retention  
   9.1 Changeover checklist with signatures and timestamps.  
   9.2 Torque verification entry for EQ-P1-L1-RR01 showing applied torque.  
   9.3 Lubricant usage record for EQ-P1-L1-CN02 showing CFW-LUB-508 lot and quantity used.  
   9.4 First-piece inspection report as per SB-1025.  
   9.5 Any deviation reports and associated corrective actions referenced to ECN-2026-003.  
   Retention: Maintain records in the document control system per plant policy and attach to the production lot file.

10. Sign-off and handover  
   10.1 Operations lead verifies completion of steps and signs the changeover checklist.  
   10.2 Maintenance verifies mechanical torque and lubrication actions and signs the maintenance verification block.  
   10.3 Quality signs the first-piece acceptance block after review of measurements and surface inspection.  
   10.4 Handover: Only after all three signatures is the line authorized to commence production. Attach related documents ECN-2026-003, SB-1009, and SB-1025 to the changeover record.

11. References  
   ECN-2026-003  
   SB-1009  
   SB-1025

12. Revision notes  
   Rev B: Consolidated torque and lubricant specifications; clarified sign-off flow and records to keep.
